name: video
title: Video
description: Record, edit and generate video — reels, demos and explainers — with a QA agent before anything goes out.
description_ar: التسجيل والمونتاج وتوليد الفيديو — ريلز وعروض وشروحات — مع وكيل مراجعة قبل أي نشر.
constraints: Claims only from real captures; generated scenes are illustrative.
No real student or parent data; brand name as the viewer sees it.
Stop at every human gate (script · look/animatic · version · publish); never approve.

quickActions.prompt: Cut a short reel from the latest video in the work folder, with Arabic captions.
quickActions.description_en: Cut a short reel from the latest video in your work folder, with Arabic captions.
quickActions.description_ar: اقطع ريلز قصيرة من آخر فيديو في مجلد عملك مع ترجمة عربية.

quickActions.prompt: Write a 60-second video script for one hogwarts feature: the idea, the shots and the voiceover.
quickActions.description_en: A 60-second script for a Hogwarts feature: the idea, the shots and the voiceover.
quickActions.description_ar: سكربت ٦٠ ثانية لميزة في هوغورتس: الفكرة واللقطات والتعليق الصوتي.

quickActions.prompt:
Plan an intro film for hogwarts (viewers see the brand Balqalam).
Audience: school owners and principals · Version: Sudan · Arabic · Destination: Facebook, vertical 9:16, mobile, about 2:00.
Goal: the viewer books the free first month. Reference: the latest video the team approved in the WhatsApp group «المدرسة 2.0», raised to cinematic level with 3D characters.
Return: the brief in one line · 3 questions with recommended answers · the journey (stage → tool → gate → reuse) · the first step.
quickActions.description_ar: موجز احترافي جاهز للتعديل: الجمهور، النسخة، المرجع، ثم خطة
quickActions.description_en: A professional brief to edit: audience, version, reference, then a plan

quickActions.prompt:
Continue the open hogwarts video production.
Read produce list and produce status for the focus version: stages done, the waiting gate, the predicted CDN URLs.
Return: where we stand in one line · what needs my decision · the next step with its tool and what it produces.
quickActions.description_ar: أين وصل الإنتاج، وما البوابة المنتظرة، وما الخطوة التالية
quickActions.description_en: Where the production stands, the waiting gate, the next step

quickActions.prompt:
Check the video line is ready.
Run produce readiness, then confirm Blender, FilmCraft and Claude actually respond, leaving proof in ~/media/_projects/_checks/<today>/.
Return: a ✓/✗ table per tool · what needs fixing and the command. Do not produce the video.
quickActions.description_ar: Blender و FilmCraft و Claude: هل تعمل؟ جدول ✓/✗ مع الدليل
quickActions.description_en: Blender, FilmCraft, Claude: do they work? A ✓/✗ table with proof

formula.en:
## Task
One line: the deliverable, for whom, which version, the goal.

## Context
The repo and brand, the project and its stage, the audience, the version (market, language, dialect), the price and currency, the destination.

## References
Every link or path the worker needs, each with what it is. A work order carries links only, never a local path.

## Constraints
What must hold: the department's rules (appended automatically) and anything specific to this piece.

## Deliverable
What comes back, where it goes and the gate it stops at. A plan turn returns the brief, the questions, the journey and the first step.

routes.description_ar: المنتج يجمع ويسأل ويقترح الرحلة، دون أي تعديل
routes.description_en: The producer gathers, asks and proposes the journey; changes nothing

routes.description_ar: المنتج ينفّذ مرحلة واحدة ويتوقف عند البوابة
routes.description_en: The producer works one stage and stops at the gate

routes.description_ar: عدة وكلاء بالتوازي: نسخة لكل وكيل، ثم تحقّق
routes.description_en: Agents in parallel: one per version, each verified
routes.suffix: Run this as a workflow: use a workflow to fan out one Sonnet agent per version (or per independent piece), verify each result, and stop at the human gates. Never Fable.

gather: `node ~/.claude/skills/produce/scripts/produce.mjs list --json{repo_flag}` and `status <ID>` of the matching project
the matching project's folder (reference video, transcript, script, asset manifest)
